scripts.build: cp index.source.html index.html && tsc && vite build && cp dist/index.html index.html && cp -r dist/assets . && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let h=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); h=h.replace(/app\.bundle\.js/g, 'app.bundle.js?t='+Date.now()).replace(/app\.bundle\.css/g, 'app.bundle.css?t='+Date.now()); fs.writeFileSync('index.html', h);"
